question: Who is regarded as the highest-qualified teacher according to the Malini teaching?
premises: The Malini teaching describes a person of innate awareness.
Such a person is the highest-qualified candidate.
A knower of this kind is regarded as a teacher.
inference: Therefore the one with innate awareness and knowledge is regarded as the highest-qualified teacher.
plain_english: Thus, according to the teaching of the revered Malini, one who possesses innate awareness is the highest-qualified. Indeed, such a knower is regarded as a teacher.
